verdict.rationale: PagerDuty's first-party docs describe webhooks that send HTTP callbacks when significant events happen in an account. These V3 webhooks are set up by creating a webhook subscription, and they offer event types for incident priority and responder changes plus filtering. Incident Workflows can also send custom webhook POSTs. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration, evidence of delivery guarantees such as retries and payload signature verification.
